title: Gini Coefficient — get_gini
text: Gini coefficient widely used economics measure income inequality. Specifically, measures income distribution among population. economics, multiple formulas used calculate coefficient (Dorfman, 1979). However, matter formula selected, low value coefficient indicates high level competition (less inequality); high value represents low level competition (greater inequality). nonprofit study, Seaman et al., (2014) supplemented HHI Gini coefficient capture concept market competition suggested market considered reasonable level equality coefficient less 0.5; market considered modest level inequality coefficient 0.5 0.75; market considered high level inequality coefficient greater .75.
